item.title: High sale prices and loan regulations... Is homeownership for the homeless drifting further away? (고분양가에 대출 규제…무주택자 내집마련 멀어지나요)
item.description:
☞What's happening in the real estate market recently? (☞최근 부동산 시장에 무슨 일이?)

Recently, there was a commotion in the third new city of Goyang Changneung District regarding the financial support for profit-sharing public sale housing. Pre-sale lottery winners staged a collective protest, and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport stepped in to resolve the issue. While the confusion over public housing financial support is problematic, complaints have also emerged that the sale prices have risen significantly compared to the estimated prices during the pre-sale phase. Amid a sharp increase in apartment sale prices in the Seoul metropolitan area for both public and private housing, and stricter loan availability, is it still the best option for homeless actual demanders to purchase new apartments? ( 최근 3기 새도시인 경기 고양창릉지구에 공급되는 이익공유형 공공분양주택의 금융 지원과 관련해 사전청약 당첨자들이 집단 항의하고 국토교통부가 수습에 나서는 등 소동이 있었는데요. 공공주택 금융 지원에 혼선이 생긴 것도 문제지만 분양가격도 사전청약 당시 추정분양가보다 크게 올랐다는 불만이 나온 상황입니다. 최근 수도권에서 공공주택과 민영주택 할 것 없이 아파트 분양가격이 큰 폭으로 상승하고 대출을 받기는 더 어려워지고 있는데요. 무주택 실수요자는 그래도 신규 아파트를 분양받는 게 최선일까요?)

Q. What kind of housing is the profit-sharing public sale in Goyang Changneung? Have the issues raised by the pre-sale winners been resolved? ( Q. 고양창릉 이익공유형 공공분양은 어떤 주택인가요? 사전청약 당첨자들이 제기했던 문제는 해결된 것인가요? )

A. The Goyang Changneung S-3 block (exclusive area 46~84㎡, 1,282 units) supplied by the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH) is a profit-sharing sale housing that underwent pre-sale in December 2022, with the main subscription scheduled from the 20th to the 29th of this month. This type of housing requires mandatory residence for at least five years, and upon disposal, LH buys it back, sharing profits with the buyer. The buyer is entitled to 70% of the repurchase profit, while LH takes 30%. <<> During the recruitment of pre-sale applicants for this housing, LH announced support for 'exclusive mortgage loans' in the notice, promising fixed interest rates of 1.9~3.0% for up to 40 years, covering up to 80% of the home price (LTV 80%), with a maximum loan limit of 500 million won. However, in the main subscription notice, the exclusive mortgage support was omitted, replaced by a notice that loans of up to 400 million won (LTV 70%) at annual rates of 1.8~4.5% would be available for those meeting the requirements for general, newlywed, or newborn baby support loans (such as the Hadum loans). In response, pre-sale winners protested that they could not afford the sale price without the exclusive mortgage, insisting that the original promise should be kept, leading to a series of related news reports. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport then issued an explanatory statement on the 7th, saying, "For pre-sale winners, we plan to provide exclusive mortgage loans from the Housing and Urban Fund without issues, up to 500 million won (LTV 80%, DSR not applied), regardless of the income and housing price requirements of the Hadum loans." However, it added that detailed loan conditions, such as interest rates and maturity, would apply the Hadum loan standards at the time of loan application. The ministry emphasized that even during the pre-sale phase, it was noted that detailed loan conditions could change based on market conditions. Pre-sale winners of the profit-sharing housing are complaining that applying the current Hadum loan standards would result in higher interest rates and a shorter maturity from 40 to 30 years, leading to disadvantages. <<> Q. How much has the sale price of the profit-sharing housing in Goyang Changneung increased compared to the estimated price during the pre-sale in 2022? <<> A. During the pre-sale, the estimated sale price for the complex was 297.9 million won for an exclusive area of 46㎡ and 552.8 million won for 84㎡. The main subscription was scheduled for March 2026 and proceeded on time without delay. However, the main subscription sale prices have risen to 366 million won (46㎡) to 707 million won (84㎡), significantly higher than the estimates. For the exclusive 84㎡, the increase amounts to 154.2 million won, a rise of 27.9%. This reflects construction cost increases due to fluctuations in raw material and labor costs, but the rise is substantial, placing a considerable financial burden on pre-sale winners. In the Goyang Changneung district, the general public sale housing for the S-4 block also saw higher-than-expected sale prices. The sale price for the standard type of the S-4 block exclusive 84㎡ is 864 million won. This raises concerns that public housing sale prices are approaching nearby market prices. According to the Ministry's real transaction disclosure system, the exclusive 84㎡ unit in the nearby Goyang Wonheung Dongil Sweet (completed in 2018) traded for 1.02 billion won (5th floor) on the 26th of last month. The sale price for the Goyang Changneung S-4 block public housing is about 10-20% lower than nearby market prices, so there is some benefit to subscribing. <<> Q. The sale price difference between profit-sharing and general public housing is significant. Given this price gap, even though 30% of the profit from future sale goes to LH, wouldn't it be better to choose the profit-sharing type? <<> A. For profit-sharing housing, LH recovers 30% of the profit upon sale after five years of residence, so the buyer's return rate depends on future housing price fluctuations, introducing uncertainty. However, the lower sale price and reduced initial payment burden are clear advantages, making it worth considering for newlyweds or older individuals with limited funds. But unlike general public housing, applicants for profit-sharing housing must meet total asset requirements. For the Goyang Changneung S-3 block profit-sharing housing, the total asset requirement for main subscription is 362 million won or less (for youth special supply: 276 million won for the applicant, 1.035 billion won for parents), including all assets like lease deposits, financial assets, and real estate (minus debts). For salaried workers in their 30s-40s or older, meeting the 362 million won total asset threshold is realistically difficult, so the pool of eligible applicants is expected to be small. Pre-sale winners from 2022 were subject to a stricter total asset requirement of 341 million won (youth special supply: 260 million won for the applicant, 975 million won for parents). Pre-sale winners who met that standard will not face asset restrictions during the main subscription. Also, unlike pre-sale winners offered exclusive mortgages, main subscription applicants are only eligible for Hadum loans for general, newlywed, or newborn baby categories, which is another point to note. <<> Q. Following the government's 'June 27 measures' and 'October 15 measures' last year, which strengthened household debt management, borrowing for public and private apartment subscriptions has become more difficult. How are the regulations on interim payment and balance payment loans applied to new apartment sales? <<> A. Due to the government's tightened loan regulations, the loan limit for mortgage loans for homeless individuals and conditional home sellers in the Seoul metropolitan area and regulated zones has been capped at 600 million won. However, this limit does not apply to interim payment loans for apartments. In regulated areas like speculation-prone zones and adjustment target areas, a loan-to-value (LTV) ratio limit of 40% applies. For example, for a new apartment in Seoul with a sale price of 1 billion won, interim payment loans can be up to 400 million won. In contrast, Goyang City in Gyeonggi Province is not a regulated zone, so for the Goyang Changneung public sale housing, while interim payment loans are not mentioned in the subscription notice, there are no restrictions on borrowing up to 60% of the sale price. LH has stated it plans to arrange loans by signing group loan agreements with commercial banks about 3-4 months before the first interim payment due date. However, unlike interim payment loans, balance payment loans are subject to the mortgage loan limit applied in the Seoul metropolitan area, which also applies to Goyang Changneung. The loan limit for homes in the Seoul metropolitan area is 600 million won for homes up to 1.5 billion won, 400 million won for homes between 1.5-2.5 billion won, and 200 million won for homes exceeding 2.5 billion won. Thus, for apartments like those in Goyang Changneung (exclusive 84㎡) with sale prices under 900 million won, if eligible for the policy-based Hadum loan at LTV 70%, buyers can receive balance payment loans of up to 600 million won to fully replace the interim payment loans. Even if not qualified for Hadum loans, the LTV 70% in non-regulated zones still applies, so getting a balance payment loan of up to 600 million won from commercial banks should not be difficult. <<> Q. In Seoul, concerns are growing that sale prices for redevelopment and reconstruction general sale apartments have risen too much, especially in the Han River belt area. Can no one stop the high pricing set by maintenance project unions? <<> A. In May, the average sale price for exclusive 84㎡ apartments in Seoul reached 2.13608 billion won, exceeding 2.1 billion won for the first time. This represents a 32.13% increase from the same month last year. Influencing this were the sales of 'The Summit The Hill' with exclusive 84㎡ units priced in the 2.9 billion won range and 'Acro River Sky' at 2.7 billion won in Dongjak-gu. The average sale price for smaller exclusive 59㎡ units also entered the 1.5 billion won range for the first time at 1.54911 billion won. This sharp rise in Seoul's new apartment prices is being driven by redevelopment and reconstruction complexes in the Han River belt areas like Mapo, Dongjak, and Seongdong, where the sale price ceiling system does not apply. Even if maintenance project unions set sale prices for general sale apartments based on recent high nearby market prices, the basic local governments that approve sales cannot intervene. Consideration should be given to expanding the sale price ceiling system, currently applied in the Gangnam 3 districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa) and Yongsan-gu, to the Han River belt areas. <<> Senior Reporter Choi Jong-hoon cjhoon@hani.co.kr ( A. 한국토지주택공사(LH)가 공급하는 고양창릉 S-3블록(전용 46~84㎡ 1282가구)은 지난 2022년 12월 사전청약이 이뤄진 이익공유형 분양주택으로 이달 20~29일 본청약이 진행됩니다. 이익공유형 분양주택은 5년 이상 의무 거주가 적용되고, 처분할 때는 엘에이치가 사들여 수분양자와 이익을 공유하는 구조입니다. 수분양자는 환매이익의 70%, 엘에이치는 30%를 가져가기로 약정돼 있습니다.)

item.title: Sold more Galaxies but still in the red?... Chipflation divides Samsung (갤럭시 더 팔았지만 적자?…칩플레이션이 갈라놓은 삼성)
item.description:
The surge in artificial intelligence (AI)-driven memory semiconductor prices is creating a divergence in fortunes among Samsung Electronics' internal business divisions. While the semiconductor (DS) division, which handles memory business, continues to post record-breaking results, the smartphone (MX) division is seeing its profitability worsen due to rising memory prices. This semiconductor super-cycle is producing contrasting outcomes within a single company: 'all-time high operating profit' in one area and 'deteriorating profitability' in another. (인공지능(AI)발 메모리 반도체 가격 급등으로 삼성전자 내부 사업부간 희비도 갈리고 있다. 메모리 사업을 하는 반도체(DS) 부문은 역대 최대 실적을 이어가고 있지만, 스마트폰(MX) 사업부는 메모리 가격 상승으로 수익성이 악화하고 있기 때문이다. 반도체 슈퍼사이클(초호황)이 한 기업 안에서 ‘역대급 영업이익’과 ‘수익성 악화’라는 상반된 결과를 낳고 있는 셈이다.)

According to a comprehensive report by The Hankyoreh on the 14th, Samsung Electronics' DS division supplies memory components, such as DRAM and NAND flash, to the MX business unit at the same market prices offered to external customers. The company explains that it does not apply separate discounts to internal transactions in order to maintain pricing consistency and customer trust. As a company that mass-produces both components and finished goods, Samsung Electronics blocks information exchange between business divisions. An internal Samsung Electronics official stated, "It's not a structure where memory is supplied at a particularly low price just because it's within the same company. The same standards as for external customers are applied," adding, "This allows for objective evaluation of each division's performance and also preserves trust with global client companies." ( 14일 한겨레 취재를 종합하면, 삼성전자 디에스 부문은 엠엑스 사업부에 디(D)램, 낸드플래시 등 메모리를 외부 고객과 같은 시장 가격으로 공급하고 있다. 가격 정책의 일관성과 고객 신뢰를 유지하기 위해 내부 거래에도 별도 할인을 적용하지 않는다는 게 회사 쪽 설명이다. 부품과 완제품을 모두 양산하는 삼성전자는 사업부 간 정보 교류를 차단하고 있다. 삼성전자 내부 관계자는 “같은 회사라고 해서 특별히 싸게 메모리를 공급하는 구조가 아니다. 외부 고객과 동일한 기준을 적용하고 있다”며 “그래야 사업부별 실적도 객관적으로 평가할 수 있고, 글로벌 고객사와의 신뢰도 유지할 수 있다”고 설명했다.)

Under this structure, the performance of business divisions moves in opposite directions, like a seesaw, depending on memory prices. On the 7th, Samsung Electronics announced preliminary results for the second quarter of this year, posting an operating profit of 89.4 trillion won. According to analysis by domestic securities firms, if the deficits of the non-memory business within the DS division and the finished goods (DX) division, which includes the smartphone business, are excluded, the memory business alone would have generated over 90 trillion won in operating profit. Some projections even suggest operating profit margins reaching as high as 80%. On the other hand, the cost burden for key components of Galaxy smartphones is rising accordingly. The MX division saw its first-quarter revenue this year increase by 3% year-on-year to 38.1 trillion won, but its operating profit dropped to 2.8 trillion won, a 35% decline from the 4.3 trillion won recorded in the same period last year. Even as smartphone sales increased, the cost burden led to a decrease in profit. Within Samsung Electronics, there are even rumors that the smartphone division shifted to its first-ever operating loss in the second quarter of this year. The Galaxy smartphone business, long a pillar of the company's performance, now appears to be hampered by rising memory prices. ( 이런 구조에서는 메모리 가격에 따라 사업부별 실적이 ‘시소게임’처럼 정반대로 움직인다. 지난 7일 삼성전자는 올해 2분기 89조4천억원의 영업이익을 거뒀다는 내용의 잠정 실적을 발표했다. 스마트폰 사업부가 포함된 완제품(DX) 부문을 비롯해 디에스 부문에 속한 비메모리 사업부의 적자를 빼면, 메모리 사업에서만 90조원이 넘는 영업이익을 거뒀을 것이란 게 국내 증권사들의 분석이다. 영업이익률만 80%에 이를 것이란 전망도 나온다. 반면 갤럭시 스마트폰의 핵심 부품 원가 부담은 그대로 늘어난다. 엠엑스 사업부는 올해 1분기 매출은 38조1천억원으로 전년 동기 대비 3% 증가했지만, 영업이익은 2조8천억원으로 지난해 같은 기간(4조3천억원)보다 35%나 줄어들었다. 스마트폰 판매량이 늘었음에도 원가 부담이 이익 감소로 이어진 셈이다. 삼성전자 내부에서는 올 2분기에 스마트폰 사업부가 사상 최초로 적자로 돌아섰다는 말도 나온다. 오랜 기간 회사 실적의 버팀목이던 갤럭시 스마트폰 사업이 이제는 메모리 가격 상승에 발목이 잡힌 모습이다.)

The cost burden is also being reflected in consumer prices. The upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, set to be unveiled on the 22nd, is expected to have a U.S. launch price of $2,099 (approximately 3.17 million won) for the 256GB model, marking the first time a main product line exceeds $2,000. The company also raised the cost of repair materials supplied to Samsung Electronics Service earlier this month due to rising raw material prices. ( 원가 부담은 소비자 가격에도 반영되고 있다. 오는 22일 공개되는 갤럭시 제트(Z) 폴드8 울트라의 미국 출고가는 256기가바이트 기준 2099달러(약 317만원)로, 주력 제품 라인 가운데 처음으로 2천달러를 넘어설 전망이다. 회사는 원자재값 상승으로 이달 초 삼성전자서비스에 납품하는 수리용 자재비도 인상했다.)

As memory price fluctuations lead to disparities in division-level profits and performance bonuses, internal conflicts are also escalating. The Samsung Electronics Union Solidarity (Solidarity Union), which has many members from the finished goods division including the mobile business, plans to hold a rally near Samsung Electronics' Suwon campus on the 16th, advocating for 'Same company, same rights'. ( 메모리 가격이 사업부별 손익과 성과급 격차로 이어지면서 내부 갈등도 커지고 있다. 모바일 사업부를 포함한 완제품 부문 조합원이 많은 삼성전자노조동행(동행노조)은 오는 16일 삼성전자 수원사업장 인근에서 ‘같은 회사, 같은 권리’를 주장하는 집회를 열 예정이다.)

Reporter Bae Ji-hyun beep@hani.co.kr ( 배지현 기자 beep@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Import prices drop 4.4% in June due to falling oil prices… Largest decline in 3 years and 6 months (유가 하락에 6월 수입물가 4.4%↓…3년6개월 만에 최대 하락)
item.description:
Driven by a decline in international oil prices, June import prices (based on the Korean won) fell relatively sharply from the previous month, while export prices held steady. (국제유가 하락에 힘입어 6월 수입물가(원화 기준)가 전월 대비 비교적 큰 폭으로 떨어지고 수출물가는 보합세를 기록했다.)

According to the 'June Export/Import Price Index and Trade Index (Preliminary)' released by the Bank of Korea on the 15th, the import price index (2020=100) stood at 161.34, down 4.4% from the previous month's 168.78. This marks the largest decline since December 2022 (-6.5%). Import prices had surged by 18.0% in March, immediately following the US-Israel and Iran war, and have since fluctuated. ( 한국은행이 15일 발표한 ‘6월 수출입물가지수 및 무역지수(잠정)’를 보면, 수입물가지수(2020년=100)는 161.34로 전월(168.78)에 견줘 4.4% 떨어졌다. 2022년 12월(-6.5%) 이후 최대 하락 폭으로 기록됐다. 수입물가는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 직후인 지난 3월 18.0% 치솟았다가 등락을 거듭하고 있다.)

Lee Moon-hee, head of the Bank of Korea's price statistics team, analyzed the downward trend in import prices, stating, "It is due to the decline in international oil prices, which led to price drops centered on mineral products (-11.3%) and coal and petroleum products (-19.0%)." The price of Dubai crude oil averaged 103.15 dollars per barrel in May but fell to 79.45 dollars in June, a decrease of 23.0%. ( 이문희 한은 물가통계팀장은 수입물가 하락 흐름에 대해 “국제유가가 내려 광산품(-11.3%), 석탄 및 석유제품(-19.0%)을 중심으로 가격이 내린 데 따른 것”으로 분석했다. 두바이유 가격은 5월 평균 배럴당 103.15달러에서 6월 79.45달러로 23.0% 떨어진 것으로 집계돼 있다. )

The year-on-year import price increase rate remains high. It rose 20.6% due to increases in mineral products and chemical goods. Although international oil prices fell in June compared to the previous month, they are still 14.7% higher (based on Dubai crude) compared to the same month last year. Regarding the outlook for future import prices, Team Leader Lee Moon-hee said, "The won-dollar exchange rate remains high, and the situation in the Middle East is becoming unstable again, making it difficult to predict." ( 전년 동월 대비 수입물가 상승률은 여전히 높은 수준이다. 광산품, 화학제품 등이 올라 20.6% 상승한 것으로 나타났다. 국제유가가 6월에 전월보다 떨어지긴 했어도 지난해 같은 달에 견줘선 14.7%(두바이유 기준) 높은 실정이다. 향후 수입물가 전망에 대해 이문희 팀장은 “원-달러 환율이 아직 높고 중동 정세가 다시 불안정해지고 있어 예단하기 어렵다”고 말했다. )

The June export price index (based on the Korean won) was 188.90, similar to the previous month's 188.82. The Bank of Korea explained that this was due to the rise in the won-dollar exchange rate and increases in computers, electronic and optical equipment (4.5%), but with declines in coal and petroleum products (-13.9%). Agricultural and fishery products rose 4.2% from the previous month, led by fruits (10.6%). The won-dollar exchange rate rose from an average of 1,490.11 won in May to 1,527.30 won in June, up 2.5% from the previous month and 11.7% year-on-year. ( 6월 수출물가지수(원화 기준)는 188.90으로 전월(188.82)과 같은 수준으로 나타났다. 원-달러 환율이 오르고, 컴퓨터·전자 및 광학기기(4.5%) 등이 올랐으나 석탄 및 석유제품(-13.9%) 가격이 내린 데 따른 것이라고 한은은 설명했다. 과일(10.6%)을 중심으로 농수산품은 전월 대비 4.2% 상승했다. 원-달러 환율은 5월 평균 1490.11원에서 6월 1527.30원으로 올랐다. 전월대비 2.5%, 전년 동월 대비로는 11.7% 상승했다.)

The year-on-year export price increase rate reached 48.9%, the highest in 28 years and 3 months since 57.1% in March 1998. This was analyzed as a result of significant increases in computers, electronic and optical equipment (117.4%), and coal and petroleum products (56.1%). ( 수출물가 상승률은 전년 동월 대비 48.9%에 이르러 1998년 3월 57.1% 이후 28년3개월 만에 최고를 기록했다. 컴퓨터·전자 및 광학기기(117.4%), 석탄 및 석유제품(56.1%) 등이 큰 폭으로 오른 데 따른 결과로 분석됐다.)

As export prices rose more than import prices, the June net barter terms of trade index stood at 110.69, up 15.6% year-on-year, continuing an upward trend for 36 consecutive months. The net barter terms of trade index measures the quantity of goods that can be imported with one unit of export revenue, indexed against the base period (2020=100). ( 수출 가격이 수입 가격보다 더 크게 오른 데 따라 6월 순상품교역지수는 110.69로 전년 동월 대비 15.6% 올라 36개월 연속 상승세를 기록했다. 순상품교역지수는 1단위 수출대금으로 수입할 수 있는 상품의 양을 기준시점(2020년=100) 대비 지수화한 것이다. )

Senior Reporter Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr ( 김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: June Employment Up by 63,000… Returns to Growth After One Month (6월 취업자 수 6만3천명↑…한달 만에 증가 전환)
item.description:
In June, the number of employed people increased by 63,000 compared to a year earlier, turning back to growth after just one month. The youth employment rate continued to decline for the 26th consecutive month. (6월 취업자 수가 1년 전보다 6만3천명 늘어나며 한달 만에 증가세로 전환했다. 청년 고용률은 2년2개월 연속 하락세를 보였다.)

According to the ‘June Employment Trends’ released by the National Data Agency on the 15th, the number of employed people last month stood at 29.154 million, an increase of 63,000 from a year earlier. This marks a return to growth after the number of employed people in May had decreased by 40,000 due to the impact of the US-Israel-Iran war. ( 국가데이터처는 15일 발표한 ‘6월 고용동향’을 보면, 지난달 취업자 수는 2915만4천명으로 1년 전보다 6만3천명 증가했다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 영향으로 5월 취업자 수가 4만명 감소했다가 한달 만에 다시 증가 전환한 것이다. )

The employment rate for those aged 15 to 64, based on the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) comparison standard, was 70.2%, down 0.1 percentage point from a year earlier. The employment rate for those aged 15 and over was 63.4%, down 0.2 percentage point from the same month last year, continuing a three-month consecutive decline. ( 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 비교 기준 15~64살 고용률은 70.2%로 1년 전보다 0.1%포인트 하락했다. 15살 이상 고용률은 63.4%로 지난해 같은 달보다 0.2%포인트 내리며, 석달 연속 하락세를 이어갔다. )

The youth (aged 15 to 29) employment rate was 43.9%, down 1.7 percentage points, marking a downward trend for 26 consecutive months since May 2024. ( 청년(15~29살) 고용률은 43.9%로 1.7%포인트 하락하며, 2024년 5월 이후 2년2개월 연속 하락세를 보였다. )

By industry, manufacturing (-97,000), agriculture, forestry, and fisheries (-95,000), and construction (-67,000) saw decreases. Wholesale and retail trade also decreased by 44,000, while domestic-demand-related sectors such as transportation and warehousing (48,000) and accommodation and food services (10,000) increased. ( 산업별로는 제조업(-9만7천명), 농림어업(-9만5천명), 건설업(-6만7천명) 등이 감소했다. 도소매업도 4만4천명 감소했으나, 내수와 관련된 운수창고업(4만8천명), 숙박음식업(1만명) 등은 증가했다. )

Bin Hyeon-jun, Director of the Social Statistics Bureau at the Data Agency, stated, “The impact of the Middle East war appears to be easing, and as consumer sentiment revives, the number of employed people in sectors like accommodation and food services has also increased.” He added, “But there is still uncertainty, so we need to monitor the situation.” ( 빈현준 데이터처 사회통계국장은 “중동 전쟁 영향이 해소되는 모습을 보이고 있고 소비심리도 살아나면서 숙박·음식업 등에서도 취업자 수가 증가했다”면서도 “여전히 불확실성이 있어 지켜볼 필요가 있다”고 말했다. )

Reporter Park Soo-ji suji@hani.co.kr ( 박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: KOSPI Surges 6% Triggering Buy Sidecar…SK Hynix ADR Skyrockets 27% (코스피 6% 급등에 매수 사이드카…하닉 ADR은 27% 폭등)
item.description:
The KOSPI surged over 5% during trading on the 15th, recovering the 7,000-point mark in just two days. This appears to be influenced by a partial recovery in investor sentiment for the semiconductor sector, as the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) came in below expectations. (코스피가 15일 장중 5% 이상 급등하며 이틀 만에 7000선을 회복했다. 미국 소비자물가지수(CPI)가 예상치를 하회하면서 반도체 업종 투자심리가 다소 회복된 영향으로 보인다.)

As of 9:16 a.m., the KOSPI stood at 7,285.58, up 6.25% from the previous day. The index opened at 7,082.91, up 3.30%, and has been rapidly expanding its gains. The KOSPI, which had plummeted 8.95% on the 13th, dropping to the 6,800-point range at the close in a single day, has now largely recovered this decline in just two days. (코스피는 이날 오전 9시16분 기준 전날보다 6.25% 오른 7285.58을 나타내고 있다. 코스피는 이날 3.30% 오른 7082.91에 출발해 급격히 상승 폭을 넓히고 있다. 지난 13일 8.95% 폭락하며 하루 만에 종가 기준 6800선까지 주저앉았던 코스피가 이틀 만에 이를 대부분 회복한 것이다.)

The KOSPI 200 futures index also rose over 5% from the previous day, triggering a buy sidecar at 9:06 a.m., which halts program buy orders for five minutes. This marks the 36th time a buy or sell sidecar has been triggered on the KOSPI market this year. It is the seventh occurrence this month, with a sell sidecar having been triggered just two days ago. (코스피200선물 지수도 전날 대비 5% 이상 오르며 오전 9시6분 프로그램 매수호가를 5분간 정지하는 매수 사이드카가 발동됐다. 유가증권시장에서 매수·매도 사이드카가 발동된 것은 올해 들어 36번째다. 이번 달 들어서는 7번째로, 불과 이틀 전 매도 사이드카가 발동한 바 있다.)

On the KOSPI market, stocks that had previously fallen sharply, particularly major semiconductor stocks, are showing a strong rally. Samsung Electronics rose 5.51% to 277,500 won, and SK Hynix traded at 2,093,000 won, up 9.41%, returning to '277,000 won Electronics' and '2 million won Hynix' levels, respectively. Large-cap stocks linked to these, such as SK Square and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, also soared by 13.03% and 7.94%, respectively. (유가증권시장에서 그동안 큰 폭으로 주가가 빠졌던 반도체 대형주 중심으로 급등세를 보이고 있다. 삼성전자는 전날보다 5.51% 오른 27만7500원, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 9.41% 오른 209만3000원에 거래되며 각각 ‘27만 전자’, ‘200만 닉스’로 복귀했다. 이들 주가와 연동된 에스케이(SK)스퀘어와 삼성전기 등 대형주도 각각 13.03%, 7.94%로 폭등 중이다.)

This is analyzed to be influenced by the overnight U.S. CPI coming in below expectations, leading to a broad rise in semiconductor stock prices. U.S. semiconductor companies like Micron Technology (+4.92%), Intel (+4.50%), and SanDisk (+5.01%) rallied, pushing the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 2.54%. SK Hynix's American Depositary Receipt (ADR) soared 27.29% overnight, seemingly improving investor sentiment toward domestic semiconductor companies. Foreign investors are net buying 400 billion won on the KOSPI market today. item.title: BOK rate hike imminent... S. Korea-U.S. long-term rate gap narrows to 3-year low (한은, 금리 인상 임박에…한-미 장기 금리차 3년 만에 최소)
item.description:
Ahead of the Bank of Korea's benchmark interest rate hike, the gap in long-term interest rates between South Korea and the United States has narrowed to its smallest in three years. (한국은행의 기준금리 인상을 앞두고 한국과 미국의 장기금리 차이가 3년 만에 최소로 좁혀졌다.)

According to the Bank of Korea's Economic Statistics System on the 15th, South Korea's 10-year government bond yield was 4.18% per annum last month, 0.29 percentage points lower than the U.S. 10-year yield (4.47%). This is the smallest gap in 2 years and 11 months since July 2023 (-0.22 percentage points). South Korea's benchmark interest rate is 2.50% per annum, 1.00 to 1.25 percentage points lower than the U.S. rate (3.50 to 3.75%). <<> After the U.S. benchmark rate rose above South Korea's in July 2022, the U.S. 10-year yield outpaced South Korea's starting in December of that year, widening to as much as 1.81 percentage points in January last year. The gap in long-term bond yields has been narrowing since the second half of last year, shrinking to 0.40 percentage points in May this year. <<> Financial markets expect the Bank of Korea to begin raising rates with the Monetary Policy Board meeting on the 16th and then possibly hike rates once more within the year. In the U.S., expectations for rate cuts have virtually disappeared due to inflation concerns, but forecasts for rate hikes and holds within the year remain mixed. <<> Along with differing outlooks on the intensity of monetary tightening between the two countries, South Korea's brighter growth prospects, boosted by strong semiconductor exports, also appear to have influenced the narrowing of the long-term rate gap. The 10-year long-term government bond yield reflects not only monetary policy outlooks but also fundamental economic conditions such as growth and inflation. A brighter economic outlook reduces demand for safe-haven long-term government bonds and increases the likelihood of inflation, pushing long-term rates higher. <<> In its recent July World Economic Outlook, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) raised South Korea's real GDP growth forecast for this year to 2.6%, up 0.7 percentage points from its April forecast of 1.9%. This is the highest among the U.S. (2.3%) and other advanced economies (South Korea, the U.S., Japan, the U.K., Germany, France, Australia, Canada, Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands). Next year's growth forecast (2.5%) is also the highest among advanced economies. In its economic growth strategy for the second half of the year announced the previous day, the government projected South Korea's GDP growth rate for this year at 3.0%. If the government's projection holds, it would be the highest growth rate in five years since 2021 (4.7%). <<> Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (15일 한국은행 경제통계시스템을 보면, 지난 달 한국의 10년 만기 국채 금리는 연 4.18%로, 미국 10년물(4.47%)에 견줘 0.29%포인트 낮았다. 2023년 7월(-0.22%포인트) 이후 2년11개월 만에 가장 작은 격차다. 한국 기준금리는 연 2.50%로 미국(3.50∼3.75%)보다 1.00∼1.25%포인트 낮은 수준이다.)

item.title: Basic Construction Cost for Ceiling on Sale Prices Rises 0.77% Due to Rebar Price Increase (철근값 상승에 분양가상한제 기본형건축비 0.77%↑)
item.description:
The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced on the 15th that it would publish an extraordinary adjustment to the basic construction cost applied to the ceiling on sale prices, reflecting the rise in rebar prices. (국토교통부는 분양가 상한제에 적용되는 기본형 건축비를 철근 가격 상승분을 반영해 15일 비정기 조정 고시한다고 밝혔다.)

The basic construction cost is one of the components that determine the upper limit of sale prices for housing subject to the ceiling on sale prices, and is regularly announced on March 1 and September 15 each year. However, in order to reflect construction cost fluctuations in sale prices in a timely manner, if the price of major construction materials fluctuates by 15% or more three months after a regular announcement, the basic construction cost is adjusted and re-notified. (기본형 건축비는 분양가 상한제가 적용되는 주택의 분양가 상한을 구성하는 항목 가운데 하나로, 매년 3월1일과 9월15일 정기적으로 고시된다. 다만 공사비 변동을 분양가에 제때 반영하고자 정기 고시 뒤 3개월이 지난 시점에 주요 건설자재 가격이 15% 이상 변동하면 기본형 건축비를 조정 고시한다.)

The ceiling on sale prices is a system that limits the sale prices of multi-unit housing such as apartments by calculating them based on certain standards to stabilize housing prices. It applies to multi-unit housing sold in public and private land areas subject to the ceiling on sale prices (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, and Yongsan districts in Seoul). (분양가 상한제는 집값 안정을 위해 아파트 등 공동주택의 분양가격을 일정한 기준으로 산정해 제한하는 제도다. 적용 대상은 공공택지와 민간택지 분양가 상한제 적용 지역(서울 강남·서초·송파·용산구)에서 분양되는 공동주택이다.)

This adjustment was made because the price of high-strength rebar, one of the major construction materials, rose by 18.6% as of early June, three months after the regular announcement in March. Following the adjustment, the basic construction cost for buildings with 16 to 25 floors or fewer, exclusive-use areas of 60 to 85 square meters, on ground floors, will increase by 0.77% from the previously announced 2,220,000 won per square meter to 2,237,000 won per square meter. (이번 조정 고시는 주요 건설자재 가운데 하나인 고강도 철근 가격이 지난 3월 정기고시 이후 3개월이 지난 6월 초 기준 18.6% 상승함에 따라 이뤄졌다. 조정 고시 이후 16∼25층 이하, 전용면적 60∼85㎡ 지상층 기준 기본형 건축비는 직전 고시된 ㎡당 222만원에서 223만7천원으로 0.77% 오른다.)

The adjusted notice will apply to apartment complexes that apply for approval of tenant recruitment after the 15th of this month. The actual sale price is determined by the local government's sale price review committee, taking into account the basic construction cost, land cost, and other additional expenses comprehensively. (조정 고시는 이달 15일 이후 입주자 모집 승인을 신청하는 단지부터 적용된다. 실제 분양가는 기본형 건축비와 택지비, 그 외 가산비용 등을 종합적으로 고려해 지방정부의 분양가심사위원회에서 결정한다.)

Jang Woo-cheol, the director of housing policy at the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, said, “We hope this adjustment to the basic construction cost will help alleviate difficulties at housing construction sites caused by the surge in construction costs due to factors such as the Middle East conflict. We will continue to provide comprehensive support to resolve housing supply difficulties on the ground.” (장우철 국토부 주택정책관은 “이번 기본형 건축비 조정이 중동전쟁 등 영향으로 공사비가 급등한 데 따른 주택 건설 현장의 애로 해소에 도움이 되길 바란다”며 “앞으로도 현장의 주택공급 애로 해소를 전방위적으로 지원해 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Thinner and Stronger... Samsung Unveils ‘Flex Titanium’ Technology for 8th Gen Foldable Phone (더 얇고 단단하게…삼성, 8세대 폴더블폰 ‘플렉스 티타늄’ 기술 공개)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics unveiled its ‘Flex Titanium’ display technology on the 15th, which will be applied to next-generation Galaxy foldable smartphones. (삼성전자가 차세대 갤럭시 폴더블 스마트폰에 적용되는 ‘플렉스 티타늄’ 디스플레이 기술을 15일 처음 공개했다.)

Samsung announced that the 8th generation foldable phone, set to be revealed at the ‘Galaxy Unpack 2026 Event’ on the 22nd, uses titanium material to enhance display durability and reduce screen creases. The newly introduced Flex Titanium technology consolidates the know-how accumulated by Samsung over the course of the 7th generation foldable smartphones, focusing on achieving both product slimness and improved durability. <<>>> First, instead of a plastic film, a ‘titanium alloy film’ and a ‘titanium plate’ have been combined to apply a proprietary titanium dual structure. Titanium is reliable enough for use in the aerospace field, but its high elasticity makes it difficult to apply to foldable displays that need to bend thinly and flexibly. However, Samsung explained that this time they overcame technical challenges and implemented it with two key components. Through an ultra-precision rolling process, it was manufactured to about one-third the thickness of a human hair, enabling display slimness. Rolling is a processing method where metal material is passed between two rotating rolls to apply pressure, thinning the thickness and elongating the length. (삼성전자는 오는 22일 ‘갤럭시 언팩 2026 행사’에서 공개되는 8세대 폴더블폰에 티타늄 소재를 활용해 디스플레이 내구성을 높이고 화면 주름을 줄였다고 밝혔다. 이번에 새롭게 선보이는 플렉스 티타늄 기술은 삼성전자가 지난 7세대 폴더블 스마트폰에 걸쳐 축적해온 노하우를 집약한 것으로, 제품의 슬림화와 내구성 향상을 함께 구현하는 데 집중했다.)

Additionally, Samsung has improved power efficiency by applying high-resolution design and next-generation new organic materials to reduce display power consumption. Moon Seong-hoon, Vice President of Hardware at Samsung Electronics’ Mobile eXperience (MX) Business, stated, “Samsung’s competitiveness lies in the combination of a deep understanding of consumer needs and technology that delivers practical value to everyday life,” adding, “The next-generation Galaxy foldable will offer an unprecedented viewing experience and completely innovate the user experience.” (먼저 플라스틱 필름 대신 ‘티타늄 합금 필름’과 ‘티타늄 플레이트’를 결합해 독자적인 티타늄 이중 구조를 적용했다. 티타늄은 항공우주 분야에 사용될 만큼 신뢰성이 높지만, 탄성이 높아 얇고 유연하게 접혀야 하는 폴더블 디스플레이에 적용하기 어려운 소재다. 그러나 이번에 기술적 난제를 극복하고 두 가지 핵심 부품으로 구현했다는 게 삼성전자의 설명이다. 초정밀 압연 공정으로 사람 머리카락 굵기의 약 3분의 1 수준으로 얇게 제작돼 디스플레이 슬림화가 가능했다고 한다. 압연은 금속 재료를 회전하는 두 개의 롤 사이로 통과시켜 압력을 가해 두께를 얇게 하고 길이를 늘어내는 가공 방식이다.)

Reporter Bae Ji-hyun beep@hani.co.kr (이밖에도 삼성전자는 고해상도 설계와 차세대 신규 유기 재료를 적용하면서 디스플레이 소비 전력을 줄여 전력 효율을 끌어올렸다. 문성훈 삼성전자 스마트폰(MX) 사업부 하드웨어 담당 부사장은 “삼성의 경쟁력은 소비자 요구에 대한 깊은 이해와 일상에 실질적인 가치를 선사하는 기술의 결합에 있다”며 “차세대 갤럭시 폴더블은 전례 없는 시청 경험을 제공하며 사용자 경험을 완전히 혁신할 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Overseas Investment Banks: "Leverage in Samsung and Hynix Contributes to Stock Market Volatility" (해외 투자은행들도 “삼전닉스 레버리지, 증시 변동성 초래 요인”)
item.description:
Overseas investment banks (IBs) are also pointing to leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix as a key factor behind the recent extreme volatility in the Korean stock market. (삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)가 최근 우리 증시의 극심한 변동성을 초래하는 주요 요인 가운데 하나라는 시각이 해외투자은행(IB)들에서도 나왔다.)

According to a report titled "Overseas Perspectives on the Recent Expansion of Domestic Stock Price Volatility" released by the Center for International Finance on the 15th, JP Morgan Private Bank noted that "leveraged ETFs amplify short-term volatility without affecting fundamentals, potentially fueling overheating risks in both upward and downward directions." (15일 국제금융센터가 내놓은 ‘최근 국내 주가 변동성 확대에 대한 해외시각’ 리포트에 따르면, 제이피(JP)모건 프라이빗뱅크는 “레버리지 ETF는 펀더멘털에 영향을 주지 않으면서 단기 변동성을 증폭시켜 상승과 하락 양방향에서 과열 위험을 초래할 소지가 있다”고 지적했다.)

Goldman Sachs also assessed that "the sharp decline in the KOSPI index on the 13th (-9%, with Samsung Electronics at -10.1% and SK Hynix at -17.0%) was not due to corporate issues like worsening semiconductor sector earnings, but rather a strong tendency toward forced liquidation of leveraged products and position unwinding driven by market sentiment." The concentration on a few semiconductor stocks like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, along with expanded individual investment in single-stock leverage for these two, heightened market vulnerability and amplified the stock price decline. (골드만삭스도 “지난 13일 코스피 지수 급락(-9%, 삼성전자 -10.1%, SK하이닉스 -17.0%)은 반도체 섹터의 실적 악화 등 기업 자체의 문제가 아니라, 레버리지 상품의 강제 청산과 시장 심리에 의한 포지션 정리 성격이 강하다”고 평가했다. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 소수 반도체주에 대한 집중과 이 두 종목 단일 레버리지에 개인들의 투자가 확대되면서 시장 취약성을 높이고 주가 하락폭을 증폭시켰다는 것이다.)

Hong Kong-based Futu Securities pointed out that "since many individual investors are using leverage, there is no structural buffer zone in the market to defend against declines," adding that "a flow that could have been a simple market adjustment expanded into a mechanical crash as margin calls and forced liquidations cascaded like dominos after the semiconductor stock decline." Bloomberg also evaluated that "the recent downturn in the Korean stock market is more attributable to profit-taking and global portfolio rebalancing rather than a reassessment of economic prospects," noting that "the rally saw broadening of gains due to concentration on a few stocks and leverage, which also widened the correction amplitude." (홍콩 기반 푸투증권도 “개인투자자 상당수가 레버리지를 활용하면서 시장에 하락을 방어할 구조적 완충지대가 없는 상황”이라며 “단순 시장 조정에 그쳤을 흐름이 반도체주 하락 직후 마진콜과 강제청산이 도미노처럼 이어지면서 기계적인 폭락 장세로 확대됐다”고 지적했다. 블룸버그도 “최근 한국 증시 하락세는 경제 전망에 대한 재평가라기보다는 차익실현 및 글로벌 포트폴리오 리밸런싱에 기인한다”며 “특히 주가 랠리 과정에서 소수 종목 집중과 레버리지 등으로 상승폭이 확대돼 조정폭도 커졌다”고 평가했다.)

If stock price volatility becomes prolonged, it could worsen consumer sentiment and corporate financing conditions. Bloomberg projected that "if stock price volatility persists, it could lead to a deterioration in consumer sentiment and a contraction in corporate financing conditions, making it difficult for the Bank of Korea to implement rapid tightening measures such as consecutive rate hikes or a 50bp increase at once." Reuters stated that "the explosive profit growth of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix is supporting stock price gains, but the upward trend is concentrated in these two stocks, and the gap with the broader real economy is wide, exposing investors to extreme volatility." (주가 변동성이 장기화되면 소비심리와 기업 자금조달 여건을 악화시킬 가능성도 지적된다. 블룸버그는 “향후 주가 변동성이 지속될 경우 소비심리 악화와 기업 자금조달 여건 위축으로 이어질 수 있어 한국은행이 연속적인 금리인상이나 한번에 금리 50bp 인상 같은 빠른 속도의 긴축을 단행하기는 어려울 것”으로 전망했다. 로이터통신은 “삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 폭발적인 이익 증가가 주가 상승을 뒷받침하고 있으나, 상승세가 두 종목에 집중되어 있고 실물경제 전반과의 괴리도 커 투자자들이 극심한 변동성에 노출돼 있다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, investment bank Citi predicted that "due to a decrease in stock valuation following the KOSPI correction, foreign demand for selling the Korean won for hedging purposes may slow, which could instead act as a pressure for won appreciation in the foreign exchange market." Foreign investors use a strategy of pre-selling the won at a specific fixed price (mainly through forward exchange sales) to prevent losses (exchange rate losses) from exchange rate fluctuations when investing in won-denominated assets like Korean stocks and bonds. (한편, 투자은행 시티는 “코스피 조정에 따른 주식 평가액 감소로 외국인의 환헤지 목적 원화 매도 수요가 둔화되면서 외환시장에서는 오히려 원화 강세 압력으로 작용할 수 있다”고 내다봤다. 외국인 투자자는 한국 주식·채권 등 원화 자산에 투자할 때 환율 변동으로 인한 손실(환차손)을 막기 위해 미리 원화를 특정 고정가격으로 매도(주로 선물환 매도)하는 전략을 쓴다.)

item.title: Fuel Subsidy for Chartered Buses to Be Paid from 16th… Approximately 250,000 Won per Bus per Month (전세버스 유가보조금 16일부터 지급…대당 월 25만원)
item.description:
A fuel cost subsidy of about 250,000 won per bus per month will be provided for chartered buses. (전세버스에 대해 대당 월 25만원 수준의 유류비 보조금이 지급된다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced on the 15th that it has revised the 'Passenger Vehicle Act Fuel Subsidy Payment Guidelines' to pay fuel subsidies for diesel used in chartered buses starting from the 16th. (국토교통부는 ‘여객자동차법 유가보조금 지급지침’을 개정해 16일부터 전세버스 경유 유가보조금을 지급한다고 15일 밝혔다.)

The target for payment is 39,000 diesel-powered chartered buses (97% of all chartered buses), and both the fuel tax-linked subsidy and the oil price-linked subsidy will be paid. The fuel tax-linked subsidy is 149 won per liter (as of July), and the oil price-linked subsidy is 98 won per liter (based on an oil price of 1,900 won per liter). Based on average usage, it is estimated that a subsidy of about 250,000 won per bus per month will be provided based on an oil price of 1,900 won per liter. (지급 대상은 경유 사용 전세버스 3만9천대(전체 전세버스의 97%)로, 유류세연동보조금과 유가연동보조금을 모두 지급한다. 유류세연동보조금은 리터당 149원(7월 기준), 유가연동보조금은 리터당 98원(유가 리터당 1900원 기준)이다. 평균사용량으로 추산할 경우 리터당 1900원 기준으로 차량 1대당 월 25만원 수준의 보조금이 지급될 것으로 보인다.)

The payment period is one year, from the 16th to July 15, 2027. If the resource security crisis warning level is raised to 'alert' or higher, or if the average selling price of diesel is 1,500 won per liter or more, it may be paid again within one year. (지급 기간은 16일부터 2027년 7월15일까지 1년이다. 자원안보 위기 경보 단계가 ‘경계’ 이상 발령되거나, 경유 평균 판매가격이 리터당 1500원 이상인 경우 1년 이내에서 다시 지급될 수 있다.)

Meanwhile, the Ministry decided to provide the fuel subsidy only when payments are made with a dedicated fuel subsidy card to prevent fraudulent receipt. Additionally, they will continuously monitor abnormal transactions such as frequent refueling, and if fraud is detected, they will fully recover the subsidy and suspend subsidy payments for all vehicles of the transport operator. (한편 국토부는 유가보조금 부정 수급을 방지하기 위해 유가보조금 전용 카드로 결제할 경우에만 보조금을 지급하기로 했다. 아울러 잦은 주유 등 이상거래를 상시 모니터링하고, 부정수급이 적발될 경우에는 보조금을 전액 환수하고 운송사업자의 모든 차량에 보조금 지급을 정지하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Park Jae-soon, head of the Ministry's Transportation and Logistics Office, said, "As the proportion of chartered buses for commuting and school transport has increased, the public nature of chartered buses has expanded compared to the past, and we have decided to pay the fuel subsidy to alleviate the burden of high oil prices due to the recent crisis in the Middle East." He added, "We hope this measure improves the treatment of chartered bus operators and workers, as well as chartered bus services, and we ask the chartered bus industry to make self-efforts to prevent fraudulent receipt of fuel subsidies and to improve user services." (박재순 국토부 교통물류실장은 “통근·통학용 전세버스 비율이 증가하는 등 전세버스의 공공성이 과거보다 확대됐고, 최근 중동사태로 인한 고유가 부담을 경감하기 위해 유가보조금을 지급하게 됐다”며 “이번 조치로 전세버스 사업자 및 근로자의 처우와 전세버스 서비스가 개선되기를 희망하며, 전세버스업계도 유가보조금 부정수급 예방을 위한 자구 노력과 이용자 서비스 개선에 힘써주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Professor Youngjae Kim's Research Team at Sogang University's Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Accepted for Full Paper Presentation at HPC Top Conference 'SC 26' (서강대학교 컴퓨터공학과 김영재 교수 연구팀,HPC분야 Top Conference ‘SC 26’ 정규 발표 논문 채택)
item.description:
A research team led by Professor Youngjae Kim (including Ph.D. candidate Soon Hwang, Master's graduate Junhyuk Park, Ph.D. candidate Jeonghyeon Yoo, and Master's candidate Seonghun Ahn) from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Sogang University (President Jonghyuk Shim) has developed a computational object storage system capable of vertical query decomposition and execution. This study proposes a hierarchical query execution technique that utilizes computational resources scattered across multiple layers within the storage system to reduce data movement by up to 99.998%. (서강대학교(총장 심종혁) 컴퓨터공학과 김영재 교수 연구팀(황순 박사과정, 박준혁 석사, 유정현 박사과정, 안성훈 석사과정)이 수직적 질의 분할 실행이 가능한 계산 가능 오브젝트 스토리지 시스템을 개발했다. 본 연구는 스토리지 시스템 내부의 여러 계층에 흩어진 연산 자원을 활용해 데이터 이동을 최대 99.998%까지 줄이는 계층적 질의 실행 기법을 제안하였다.)

The paper, 'OASIS: Hierarchical Query Execution over Multi-Layer Computation-Enabled Object Storage,' conducted jointly with SK hynix's Memory System Research Institute and the Los Alamos National Laboratory in the U.S., has been accepted as a full paper for SC 26 (The 38th International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis), the world's most prestigious conference in the field of high-performance computing. This year's paper acceptance rate was 19.4%. (SK하이닉스 메모리 시스템 연구소, 미국 Los Alamos National Laboratory와 공동으로 수행된 ‘OASIS: Hierarchical Query Execution over Multi-Layer Computation-Enabled Object Storage’ 논문은 고성능 컴퓨팅 분야 세계 최고 권위 학회인 SC 26(The 38th International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis)에 정규 논문(full paper)으로 채택되었다. 올해 논문 채택률은 19.4%였다.)

()

In large-scale scientific data analysis, the process of moving tens of gigabytes of data from storage to analysis servers itself becomes a performance bottleneck. To mitigate this, techniques have been used where storage performs simple operations, such as filtering, before sending data. However, these methods only reduce the data exiting the storage, leaving intact the movement of data from the enclosure containing the disks to the storage server within the storage device. The research team identified that the core issue is not 'which operations to perform on storage' but rather a placement problem of 'at which layer within the storage to offload execution,' and developed the OASIS system to address this. The core algorithm of OASIS, SODA, predicts the data reduction rate of each operation using only statistics collected at the time of storage, without actually reading the data, and automatically finds the optimal partition point that minimizes data movement between layers. Evaluation with real scientific workloads showed that internal data movement decreased from 20GB to 76KB, and end-to-end latency was reduced by up to 25.1% compared to existing state-of-the-art systems. (대규모 과학 데이터 분석에서는 수십 GB의 데이터를 스토리지에서 분석 서버로 옮기는 과정 자체가 성능의 병목이 된다. 이를 완화하기 위해 스토리지가 데이터를 보내기 전에 필터링 같은 간단한 연산을 미리 수행하는 기술이 사용되어왔으나, 이 방식은 스토리지 바깥으로 나가는 데이터만 줄일 뿐, 스토리지 장비 내부에서 디스크가 담긴 인클로저로부터 스토리지 서버로 데이터를 끌어올리는 이동은 그대로 남겨둔다. 연구팀은 문제의 본질이 ‘어떤 연산을 스토리지에서 할 것인가‘가 아니라 ’스토리지 내부의 어느 계층에서 실행을 끊을 것인가‘라는 배치의 문제임을 규명하고, 이를 해결하는 시스템 OASIS를 개발하였다. OASIS의 핵심 알고리즘 SODA는 데이터를 실제로 읽지 않고도 저장 시점에 수집한 통계만으로 각 연산의 데이터 축약률을 예측하여, 계층 간 데이터 이동이 최소가 되는 최적의 분할 지점을 자동으로 찾아낸다. 실제 과학 워크로드 평가 결과 내부 데이터 이동이 20GB에서 76KB로 감소하였고, 기존 최신 시스템 대비 종단 간 지연 시간을 최대 25.1% 단축하였다.)

()

This study holds academic significance as it redefines the existing dichotomous perspective on storage-side computation into a layer placement optimization problem. Notably, it quantitatively demonstrates that offloading is not always beneficial and can even be detrimental under certain conditions, providing design guidelines for future related research. From an industrial perspective, the system is practical as it can be implemented using only the existing resources of standard storage equipment without dedicated hardware, maintains the standard S3 interface for full compatibility with existing analysis engines, and can thus be immediately applied to large-scale data analysis infrastructure in data centers. Furthermore, the reduction in data movement leads to energy savings, which is expected to contribute to the sustainability of rapidly power-consuming AI and data infrastructure. (본 연구는 스토리지 측 연산에 관한 기존의 이분법적 시각을 계층 배치 최적화 문제로 재정의했다는 점에서 학술적 의의를 가지며, 특히 오프로딩이 항상 이득은 아니며 특정 조건에서는 오히려 손해가 될 수 있음을 정량적으로 규명하여 향후 관련 연구의 설계 지침을 제시하였다. 산업계 측면에서는 별도의 전용 하드웨어 없이 기존 스토리지 장비의 자원만으로 구현 가능하고 표준 S3 인터페이스를 유지하여 기존 분석 엔진과 그대로 호환되므로 데이터센터의 대규모 데이터 분석 인프라에 즉시 적용될 수 있는 실용성을 갖추었다. 또한 데이터 이동 감소는 곧 에너지 절감으로 이어져, 전력 소비가 급증하는 AI·데이터 인프라의 지속가능성 측면에서도 기여가 기대된다.)

()

The first author, Ph.D. candidate Soon Hwang, explained the research results, stating, "While the utility of storage-side computation has been consistently raised, the situation where resources within the storage system are not fully utilized has persisted. By redefining this as a placement problem of which layer within the storage to offload execution, our research team aimed to actually utilize the hierarchical resources from the enclosure to the storage server, thereby resolving the bottleneck of internal data movement that had not been revealed until now." He added, "I am grateful to Professor Youngjae Kim for his guidance, and to the researchers at SK hynix and Los Alamos National Laboratory for their collaboration." (제1저자인 황순 박사과정은 "스토리지 측 연산의 효용성은 꾸준히 제기되어 왔으나, 정작 스토리지 시스템 내부의 자원을 충분히 활용하지 못하는 상황이 지속되어 왔다“라며 ”연구팀에서는 이를 스토리지 내부의 어느 계층에서 실행을 끊을 것인가라는 배치 문제로 다시 정의함으로써, 인클로저부터 스토리지 서버에 이르는 계층별 자원을 실제로 쓰이게 만들고자 했고, 그 결과 지금까지 드러나지 않았던 내부 데이터 이동이라는 병목을 해결할 수 있었다“라고 연구 성과를 설명했다. 이어 ”지도해 주신 김영재 교수님, 함께 연구해 주신 SK하이닉스 연구진과 Los Alamos National Laboratory 연구진께 감사드린다"라고 소감을 전했다.)

()

The International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis (SC), established in 1988, is the world's most prestigious international conference where researchers, system designers, and industry experts in the high-performance computing (HPC) field gather to share the latest advancements in computing, storage, and data analysis. Maintaining a low acceptance rate through rigorous peer review each year, this top-tier conference is scheduled to be held from November 15 to 20 this year at McCormick Place in Chicago, USA. The accepted full research papers will be presented in the Technical Program. (The International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis (SC)는 1988년 창설 이후 고성능 컴퓨팅(HPC) 분야의 연구자, 시스템 설계자, 산업계 전문가가 모여 컴퓨팅과 스토리지, 데이터 분석의 최신 성과를 공유해 온 세계 최고 권위의 국제 학술대회이다. 매년 엄격한 동료 평가를 거쳐 낮은 채택률을 유지하는 최우수 학회로, 본 학회는 올해 11월 15일부터 20일까지 미국 시카고 McCormick Place에서 개최될 예정이며, 채택된 정규 연구 논문은 기술 프로그램(Technical Program)에서 발표된다.)

item.title: National Growth Fund expanded to 200 trillion won... Introduction of 1 million won long-term loans for vulnerable groups (국민성장펀드 200조원으로 확대…취약계층 100만원 장기대출 도입)
item.description:
The National Growth Fund, which invests in domestic high-tech industries, will expand from the current 150 trillion won to 200 trillion won. Small loans for low-credit vulnerable groups, allowing repayment of 1 million won over 10 years, will be introduced, and plans to convert card points into local currency to boost regional consumption will also be pursued. (국내 첨단산업에 투자하는 국민성장펀드가 기존 150조원에서 200조원으로 몸집을 키운다. 저신용 취약계층을 대상으로 100만원을 10년에 걸쳐 나눠 갚는 소액대출이 도입되고, 카드 포인트를 지역화폐로 바꿔 지역 소비를 촉진하는 방안도 추진된다.)

The Financial Services Commission announced its work plan for the second half of 2026 on the 15th. The commission presented three pillars for the second-half operations: institutionalizing productive and inclusive finance, and promoting financial market stability and innovation. (금융위원회는 이런 내용의 2026년 하반기 업무계획을 15일 발표했다. 금융위는 생산적·포용적 금융을 제도화하고 금융시장 안정·혁신을 추진하는 것을 하반기 업무의 세 축으로 제시했다.)

First, the five-year operating scale of the National Growth Fund will be expanded from the current 150 trillion won to 200 trillion won. The National Growth Fund is a project that pools funds from the government and private financial institutions to invest in high-tech industries such as semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI), and biotechnology, as well as related companies. Accordingly, the annual operating scale will increase from 30 trillion won to 40 trillion won, and future strategic industries such as space and aerospace will be added to the current 12 high-tech industries as investment targets. (먼저 국민성장펀드의 5년간 운용 규모를 기존 150조원에서 200조원으로 확대한다. 국민성장펀드는 정부와 민간 금융사의 자금을 모아 반도체·인공지능(AI)·바이오 등 첨단산업과 관련 기업에 투자하는 사업이다. 이에 따라 연간 운용 규모는 30조원에서 40조원으로 늘어나고, 투자 대상도 기존 12개 첨단산업에 우주·항공 등 미래 전략산업을 추가한다.)

The Korea Strategic Technology Partners (KSTP) will also be established for long-term investment in core technologies. As a specialized management company jointly invested by policy financial institutions like the Korea Development Bank and private financial firms, it will invest up to 10 trillion won over five years in technologies and industries requiring long-term investment of over a decade, such as quantum computing and ultra-large offshore wind power. Separately, an 880 billion won "ultra-long-term technology investment fund" will be created to supply funds through equity investment to technology companies that take more than 10 years to recover investments. (핵심기술에 장기간 투자하기 위한 한국전략기술파트너스(KSTP)도 신설한다. 산업은행 등 정책금융기관과 민간 금융회사가 공동 출자하는 전문 운용사로, 5년간 최대 10조원을 양자컴퓨팅, 초대형 해상풍력 등 10년 이상의 장기 투자가 필요한 기술과 산업에 투입한다. 이와 별도로 8800억원 규모의 ‘초장기 기술투자펀드’도 조성해 투자금 회수까지 10년 이상 걸리는 기술기업에 지분투자 방식으로 자금을 공급한다.)

A "Startup Build-up Guaranteed Loan" for early-stage startups lacking collateral and credit will also launch in August. It will provide up to 100 million won in the first year, and if growth potential is confirmed, the support limit will be increased to up to 200 million won over two years. After the program ends, principal repayment will be deferred for three years. (담보와 신용이 부족한 초기 스타트업을 위한 ‘스타트업 빌드업 보증부대출’도 8월 출시한다. 첫해 최대 1억원을 지원하고, 성장성이 확인되면 2년간 지원 한도를 최대 2억원으로 늘린다. 프로그램이 종료된 뒤에는 원금 상환을 3년간 유예해 준다.)

Policy-based microfinance for vulnerable groups will also be expanded. A new long-term small loan will be introduced, lending 1 million won at an annual interest rate of 4.5% to low-credit individuals after in-person screening, with repayment over 10 years. The monthly repayment amount is approximately 10,000 won. During counseling, the borrower's financial circumstances will be reviewed, and if welfare or employment support is needed, they will be connected to related programs. Those who repay faithfully will be linked to larger amounts of policy finance or bank loans. An interest refund system will be introduced for the Sunshine Loan special guarantee. Borrowers who receive a 12.5% annual interest rate and repay diligently will receive about half of the interest paid back, lowering the final effective interest rate to 6.3%. (취약계층을 위한 정책서민금융도 확대한다. 대면 심사를 거친 저신용자에게 100만원을 연 4.5% 금리로 빌려주고, 10년에 걸쳐 갚도록 하는 장기 소액대출을 신설한다. 월 상환액은 약 1만원이다. 상담 과정에서 대출자의 경제적 사정을 살펴 복지·고용 지원이 필요한 경우 관련 제도와 연결하고, 성실하게 갚으면 더 큰 금액의 정책금융이나 은행 대출을 이용할 수 있도록 연계할 계획이다. 햇살론 특례보증에는 이자 환급 제도를 도입한다. 연 12.5% 금리를 적용받은 대출자가 성실하게 상환하면 낸 이자의 절반가량을 돌려줘 최종 부담 금리를 6.3%로 낮추는 방식이다.)

To revitalize the local economy, plans will be pursued to allow various membership points accumulated from card companies and others to be converted into local currency. Guaranteed loans worth 200 billion won with interest rates reduced by up to 1.5 percentage points will be provided to promising startups led by young entrepreneurs, and the use of non-financial information, such as telecommunication bill payment records, will be expanded to help young people lacking financial transaction history obtain credit cards. (지역경제 활성화를 위해 카드사 등에서 적립한 각종 멤버십 포인트를 지역화폐로 바꿀 수 있도록 하는 방안도 추진한다. 청년 대표의 유망 창업기업에는 금리를 최대 1.5%포인트 낮춘 2천억원 규모의 보증부대출을 공급하고, 금융거래 이력이 부족한 청년이 신용카드를 발급받을 수 있도록 통신요금 납부 이력 등 비금융정보 활용을 확대하기로 했다.)

Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hassabis: AGI Comparable to Discovery of Fire and Electricity... U.S.-Led Regulatory Body Needed (허사비스 “AGI, 전기·불 발견 비견…미국 주도 규제기구 세워야”)
item.description:
Nobel laureate and CEO of Google DeepMind, Demis Hassabis, has proposed the creation of a new U.S.-led artificial intelligence standards body, emphasizing that the development of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is imminent. (노벨상 수상자이자 구글 딥마인드 최고경영자(CEO)인 데미스 허사비스가 범용인공지능(AGI) 개발이 눈앞에 다가온 만큼 미국이 주도하는 인공지능 표준 기구를 신설해야 한다고 제안했다.)

In a personal blog post on the 14th (local time), Hassabis predicted, "There is a high likelihood that AGI—a system capable of performing all cognitive abilities of the human brain—will emerge within just a few years," adding, "When we look back decades from now, we will realize we were standing at the dawn of a singularity." He stressed the impact of AGI, stating, "It cannot be compared to major technological innovations like the internet or mobile phones. Rather, it is much closer to the discovery of electricity or fire." (허사비스 최고경영자는 14일(현지시각) 개인 블로그에 글을 올려 “인간의 뇌가 지닌 모든 인지 능력을 발휘하는 시스템인 범용인공지능이 불과 몇 년 안에 등장할 가능성이 크다”며 “수십 년이 지나 이 시기를 되돌아볼 때 우리는 당시 특이점의 초입에 서 있었다는 사실을 깨닫게 될 것”이라고 내다봤다. 그는 범용인공지능의 파급력에 대해 “인터넷이나 모바일처럼 중대한 기술 혁신과도 비교할 수 없다”며 “오히려 전기나 불의 발견에 훨씬 가깝다”고 강조했다.)

He emphasized the need for a "cautious optimism" approach, given the conflicting forecasts surrounding AI. Hassabis noted, "No one in the world knows for sure what will happen from now on, and even experts are divided," adding, "When uncertainty is high and stakes are significant, moving forward with cautious optimism is a rational and correct strategy." (그는 인공지능과 관련한 여러 전망이 엇갈리는 상황에서 ‘신중한 낙관주의’에 따른 접근이 필요하다고 했다. 허사비스는 “지금부터 어떤 일이 벌어질지 확실히 아는 사람은 세계 어디에도 없으며 전문가들조차 의견이 갈린다”며 “불확실성이 크고 이해관계가 중대할 때는 신중한 낙관주의를 바탕으로 나아가는 것이 합리적이고 올바른 전략”이라고 밝혔다.)

To that end, he stressed the need for a regulatory framework to guide AI for societal benefit, stating that the U.S. is well-suited to establish it. "Given its economic and technological stature, the U.S. is in a favorable position to take the first steps in developing such a framework," he said. He proposed, "A new standards body could be established, modeled on a public-private partnership under U.S. government oversight or a self-regulatory organization like the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)." (이를 위해 인공지능이 사회에 이익이 되도록 이끌 감독 체계가 필요하며, 미국이 이를 구성하는 데 적합하다고 강조했다. “미국은 경제적, 기술적 위상을 고려할 때 이러한 체계를 개발하기 위한 첫걸음을 내딛기 유리한 위치에 있다”는 이유에서다. 그러면서 “미국 정부의 감독을 받는 민관 협력체나 금융산업규제기구(FINRA)와 같은 자율규제기구를 본떠 새로운 표준기구를 설립할 수 있다”고 제안했다.)

Hassabis also suggested a mechanism where leading AI labs voluntarily submit their models to the standards body up to 30 days before release, for evaluations on cybersecurity, biological risks, and other areas. Additionally, he mentioned a tiered approach to regulatory intensity, where labs would be guided to slow development if a model's severity is confirmed. He emphasized that this approach "focuses on technology while supporting innovation and encouraging responsible behavior." (허사비스는 또한 최첨단 인공지능 연구소가 모델 출시 최대 30일 전에 표준기구에 자발적으로 모델을 제출하고, 사이버보안·생물학적 위험 등의 평가를 받는 방식 등을 제시했다. 아울러 모델의 심각성이 확인되는 경우, 규제 강도를 단계적으로 높여 연구소들이 개발 속도를 늦추도록 조율하는 방안도 언급했다. 그는 이 같은 접근법이 “기술에 초점을 맞추면서도 혁신을 지원하고 책임 있는 행동을 장려한다”고 강조했다.)

Hassabis concluded, "There are enormous expectations and uncertainties surrounding AI, both well-founded," but added, "The future is not yet written. Before AGI arrives, we must seize this precious opportunity to steer its development in a direction that benefits all of humanity." (허사비스는 “인공지능을 둘러싼 엄청난 기대와 불확실성이 공존하며, 두 가지 모두 충분한 근거가 있다”면서도 “아직 미래는 쓰이지 않았다. 범용인공지능이 도래하기 전에 우리에게 주어진 이 소중한 기회를 활용해 인류 전체에 이익이 되는 방향으로 발전하도록 만들어야 한다”고 했다.)

By Kang Jae-gu, Reporter j9@hani.co.kr (강재구 기자 j9@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Strong Corporate Earnings Drive Money Supply Expansion in May (기업 실적 호조, 5월 통화 팽창으로 이어져)
item.description:
Due to an influx of corporate short-term surplus funds and deposits from semiconductor companies, the money supply expanded by over 30 trillion won in May. (기업의 단기 여유 자금과 반도체 기업의 예치자금 유입으로 지난 5월 한 달 통화량이 30조원 넘게 불어난 것으로 나타났다.)

According to the 'Money and Liquidity' statistics released by the Bank of Korea on the 15th, the average outstanding balance of broad money (M2) in May stood at 4,184.4 trillion won, up 32.2 trillion won (0.8%) from the previous month. This increase is the largest since August of last year (44.5 trillion won) and marks the fourth-highest on record. In April, broad money also saw a relatively large increase of 25.3 trillion won (0.6%) compared to the previous month. The uptrend in broad money has continued for seven months since November last year. Year-on-year, it rose by 5.8%, the highest since February 2023 (6.2%). (한국은행이 15일 공개한 ‘5월 통화 및 유동성’ 통계를 보면, 5월 광의통화(M2) 평잔은 4184조4천억원으로 전월보다 32.2조원(0.8%) 늘었다. 이런 증가 폭은 지난해 8월(44.조5천억원) 이후 가장 크며 역대로는 네번째 기록치다. 광의통화는 지난 4월에도 전달에 견줘 비교적 큰 폭인 25조3천억원(0.6%) 늘어난 바 있다. 광의통화 증가세는 지난해 11월 이후 7개월째 이어졌다. 전년 동월대비로는 5.8% 늘어 2023년 2월(6.2%) 이후 가장 높았다.)

Broad money, a broad measure of the money supply, includes cash, demand deposits, and savings deposits with easy withdrawal (all under M1), as well as short-term financial instruments that can be quickly converted to cash, such as money market funds (MMFs), time deposits and installment savings with maturities under two years, certificates of deposit (CDs), repurchase agreements (RPs), financial bonds with maturities under two years, and money in trust with maturities under two years. (넓은 의미의 통화량 지표인 광의통화에는 현금, 요구불예금, 수시입출금식 예금(이상 M1) 외에 머니마켓펀드(MMF), 2년 미만 정기 예·적금, 양도성예금증서(CD), 환매조건부채권(RP), 2년 미만 금융채, 2년 미만 금전신탁 등 곧바로 현금화할 수 있는 단기 금융상품이 포함된다.)

The Bank of Korea explained that the increase in broad money was primarily driven by a 24.3 trillion won rise in savings deposits with easy withdrawal compared to the previous month. In April, the increase was only around 700 billion won. This rise in savings deposits with easy withdrawal was attributed to corporate short-term surplus funds and expanded fund management by some other financial institutions related to securities and derivatives markets. Additionally, money in trust with maturities under two years grew by 3.8 trillion won, fueled by deposits from semiconductor companies, which was also cited as a major factor in the broad money expansion. This indicates that strong export performance and improved corporate earnings, especially in the semiconductor sector, have led to increased market liquidity. (광의통화량 증가는 수시입출식 저축성예금이 전달보다 24조3천억원 늘어난 데서 주로 영향을 받은 것이라고 한은은 설명했다. 4월의 증가 폭은 7천억원 수준이었다. 기업의 단기 여유 자금과 일부 기타금융기관의 증권·파생상품시장 관련 자금 운용 확대가 수시입출식 저축성 예금 증가로 이어진 것으로 분석됐다. 반도체 기업의 예치자금 유입에 힘입어 2년 미만 금전신탁이 3조8천억원 늘어난 것도 광의통화 증가의 주요인으로 꼽혔다. 반도체 부문을 중심으로 수출 호조와 기업 실적 개선이 시중 유동성 확대로 이어졌음을 보여준다.)

By sector, the average outstanding balance of broad money for non-financial corporations (including public and private companies) surged by 30.1 trillion won, marking a notable increase. Other financial institutions (such as insurance companies and pension funds) saw a rise of 11.8 trillion won, while the other sectors (including social security organizations and local governments) increased by 3 trillion won. In contrast, households and non-profit organizations saw a decrease of 19 trillion won. The decline in household broad money is interpreted as a result of personal funds shifting toward stock investments. This is reflected in the fact that under the previous standard, which includes beneficiary certificates, broad money increased by 2.2% month-on-month and 11.7% year-on-year. (주체별 광의통화량을 보면, 비금융기업(공기업, 민간기업 등)에서 30조1천억원 늘어 두드러진 증가 폭을 기록했다. 기타 금융기관(보험기관, 연금기금 등) 11조8천억원, 기타부문(사회보장기구 및 지방정부)에선 3조원 늘었고, 가계 및 비영리단체는 19조원 줄었다. 가계부문의 광의통화 감소는 개인 자금이 주식투자 쪽으로 이동한 데서 비롯된 것으로 풀이된다. 수익증권을 포함하는 옛 기준 광의통화량이 전월 및 전년 동월대비로 각각 2.2%, 11.7% 늘어난 데서 이를 엿볼 수 있다.)

In May, the average outstanding balance of narrow money (M1) was 1,398.2 trillion won, up 1.9% from the previous month and 10.0% year-on-year. In April, the growth rates were 0.5% and 8.3%, respectively. The average outstanding balance of liquidity of financial institutions (Lf), which aggregates funds of all financial institutions, stood at 6,309 trillion won, up 1.4% from the previous month. Meanwhile, broad liquidity (L), including government and corporate bonds, increased by 1.1% from the end of the previous month on a closing balance basis. (5월 협의통화(M1) 평잔은 1398조2천억원으로 전월대비 1.9%, 전년 동월대비로는 10.0% 증가한 것으로 나타났다. 4월의 증가율은 각각 0.5%, 8.3%였다. 모든 금융기관의 자금을 합친 금융기관유돟성(Lf, 평잔)은 6309조원으로 전월대비 1.4% 늘었고, 금융기관 유동성에 정부·기업 발행 채권까지 포함한 광의유동성(L, 말잔)은 전월말대비 1.1% 증가한 것으로 집계됐다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)
